mission.access_protocol: Public operations use world-call with arguments {operation: public name, body: operation-specific object}. C0 assigns request_id. This catalogue defines available access, not an investigation sequence. Native EDI component operations and selective teacher review are also available through the configured controller.
mission.objective: Investigate the recorded change in instrument readings. Determine what the available information supports about the change and a next-reading prediction. Obtain information as needed, then submit findings, uncertainty and any further information needed.

ask.returns: available interview record; unsupported requests remain unknown

read.returns: raw document, source attribution and digest

mission.scope: Authored neutral instrument engineering environment; no forest case or empirical science.

state.usage_basis: known reported counts plus full reservation for unknown usage; not an energy/cost measurement
